name: Alert status
description: The handling code for an alert, from OASIS CAP 1.2. Anything other than 'actual' must never be rendered to the public as a real warning; publishing a test without this field is dangerous, which is why it is required.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Exercise
hasDefinedTerm.description: A drill. Addressees must treat it as an exercise, never as real.

hasDefinedTerm.name: System
hasDefinedTerm.description: A message for system or network operators, not the public.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Test
hasDefinedTerm.description: A technical test. Recipients should disregard it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Draft
hasDefinedTerm.description: Not yet issued; a preliminary template.
